stem_book: Given that tanA, tanB are the roots of the equation x^(2) − bx + c = 0, the value of sin^(2)(A + B) is: (a) b/(b + c)^(2) (b) b^(2)/(b^(2) + c^(2)) (c) b^(2)/(c^(2) + (1 − b^(2))) (d) b^(2)/(b^(2) + (1 − c)^(2))
reason: Print (d) reads b²/(b² + (1 − c²)) — misprint for (1 − c)² (the derivation gives (1 − c)² and no other option fits); corrected stem given.
work: tan(A+B) = b/(1 − c) ⇒ sin²(A+B) = tan²/(1 + tan²) = b²/(b² + (1 − c)²)
